_comment: Goes in the TARGET repo at .pi/models.json.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Until 2026-09-16 the pipeline sent no sampling
parameters at all. Pi only sends them when something defines them, and
OpenRouter does not substitute a default — it omits the parameter upstream
and whichever provider serves the request applies its own. A `:free` model
routes across several providers, so the sampling that produced any given
token was chosen by whoever answered, and a retry can land somewhere else.
That is `NOTES.md` 43, and it is the leading candidate for the token soup
`samplingParams` is merged VERBATIM into the request body and its keys win
(`models.md`), so it carries both the sampling AND OpenRouter's top-level
`provider` routing block. One field, both hypotheses.
UNVERIFIED, deliberately: OpenRouter warns that sending values explicitly
can affect provider-side cache keys, and its documentation says nothing
about how provider routing interacts with `:free` variants. We are finding
out by running it. If this file makes things worse, delete it — that is a

No `sort`. Sorting by throughput selects the fastest node, which is also how you find a heavily quantised one — the opposite of what we are testing. `require_parameters: true` restricts routing to providers that actually honour the sampling we send, which is the point of sending it.
